name: Kimeramon
_reparent: DW2 hangs the tail (DW1 bone 28) from the entity, a second root; under the pelvis it follows the hips of the retargeted slots
_map: DW1 bone (= DW2 bone + 1) <- MetalGreymon bone: pelvis, chest, neck, head, jaw; the black upper arms (6-8, 9-11) <- its arms; the white wings (18, 19) <- its wings; legs; tail. The pale lower arms (12-17) and the red wings (20, 21) are not mapped: DW2's own idle moves them (layer)
_clips: DW2's battle animations (ref/DW2-PC fighter.c): A0 idle, B0 hit, C0-C2 knocked down (fall, bounce, settle), J0 getting up, F0/G0/H0 the three technique casts, I0 the second action. DW2 has no victory: 0x2A stays MetalGreymon's
_eyes: MetalGreymon's eye frames (texture moves to its eye at (4, 0)): x 22 open, 18 half, 14 closed, 10 angry (no such art in DW2: open)
_effectOrigins: MetalGreymon's origins on Kimeramon's DW2 skeleton (bone-local, 400 units): its head (4, and the neck 3) -> Kimeramon's head (4): Heat Laser 40 units in front of the snout, the rest at the mouth; its right hand (9) -> the black right claw (8); its hips (18) -> the pelvis (1) (import_batch.effect_origins). Snout, mouth and claw measured on the mesh
